components.institution_label: Active-Service Modified-Duties Policy for Tenured and Tenure Track Faculty
components.description: After a birth or adoption by a tenured/tenure-track faculty member or spouse, the faculty member who is the primary caregiver may elect one semester of relief from scheduled teaching and university service at full pay; research and advising continue. Usable twice per career; one-year return obligation.

notes: Reference date 2018-02-27. Policy in force: PSA/AAUP Agreement 2015-2019 (2018_01), Faculty Handbook July 2017 (2018_04), NJIT Family Leave Policy issued May 2014 (2018_00; the agreement Art. VIII.B cites its URL as the university's Family Leave Policy). The July 2016 handbook (2018_02) is superseded (context only); the April 2017 Senate motion (2018_03) is a proposal (context only).

2018_01 appendices A-L (pp. 62-83) are image pages with no transcribed text except Appendix K; they hold no leave policy as far as the titles show (evaluation form, salary matrices, pay dates, teaching load agreement, tuition remission, class size, professors of practice).

Chain, birth parent: Family Leave own-health leave I.D (c5, 12 wk, sick balance charged concurrently, c7) -> Family Leave birth/child care I.A (c4, 12 wk, consecutive_after c5 by S1a) with NJ FLI (c8, 6 wk) concurrent with c4; Active-Service Modified-Duties (c1, one semester of teaching and service relief at full pay) unlinked (no stated order relative to the leaves).

Chain, non-birth parent: Family Leave birth/child care I.A (c4, 12 wk) with NJ FLI (c8, 6 wk) concurrent; Active-Service Modified-Duties (c1) if the primary caregiver, unlinked. Family-illness leave (c6) shares the 12-week cap with c4 (leave_limits).

Whose figures: a tenure-stream member with two years of service meets the Family Leave service tests (12 months and 1,000/1,250 hours, presumed for FLSA-exempt faculty) and the NJ TDB-law earnings test for FLI (U8).

The ASMD period and the TTP extension: the agreement (Art. VIII.D.1.d, made Nov 2016) makes the one-year TTP extension automatic for a tenure-track primary caregiver unless declined in writing; the July 2017 handbook 4.3.3.2 still says electing ASMD does not replace a written request. Coded by the agreement's specific provision (source precedence), flagged conflicting_sources on c2. The April 2017 Senate motion (2018_03) proposed aligning the handbook; outcome not shown.

Not components: Family Leave military exigency and military caregiver leave (I.E, I.F) and the 26-week combined FMLA total, which concerns military caregiver leave; health-premium advance for up to three months of unpaid leave (PSA XIV.A.2), benefit continuation; merit-increase protection for faculty on Family Leave or sick leave for a full semester (PSA X.B.8), salary treatment; sabbatical and Competitive Fellowship leave (not usable for a birth); bereavement use of sick leave.
July 2016 handbook 6.9 (superseded): unpaid leave 'at the discretion of the President', two years' service; replaced by the agreement's Art. VIII.C (c9).
Family Leave Policy V: 12-month 'rolling' leave year; VI.B health coverage maintained with employee contributions; VI.E reinstatement to the same or an equivalent position.

Cross-references not saved (none governs a coded provision's terms): the university's 'other standing leave policies', 'sick leave policy' and 'unpaid leave policy' named in the Family Leave Policy VI.C (for faculty the agreement's articles were read); federal rules and regulations on family leave (next of kin definition); Guidelines for Sabbatical Leave Applications; Competitive Fellowship Leave Program; Faculty Search and Selection Guidelines; Guidelines for Graduate Faculty; Default Department Bylaws; University Code on Academic Integrity; shared-governance documents; Memorandum of Understanding on Large Class Size (Appendix J, image only); University Tuition Remission Policy (Appendix I, image only).
